formalization.objective: Minimise the elastic strain energy density h(ε) in meV/Å^3.
constraints: Eg ≤ 0.80 eV (1239.84/1550 nm), so 1550 nm photons can be absorbed; a direct gap is not required (phonon-assisted absorption at an indirect gap is allowed)
Eg evaluated at HSE06 level: screened with per-valley scissor corrections on PBE valley energies (Δ +0.582, L +0.763, Γ +0.764 eV), to be confirmed by full HSE06
Born stability: all eigenvalues of the elastic stiffness matrix at the strained state must be positive
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT for h and valley energies; HSE06 (scissor, then full verify_hse) for the gap constraint
formalization.subspace: All 6 Green-Lagrange Voigt components (e11,e22,e33,e23,e13,e12), each bounded to |ε| ≤ 0.10
formalization.stability: Born elastic stability (elastic_stability) required at the final strain

designer.explanation: Best DFT-checked candidate: 2.6% compression along [100] with about 1% tension along the two other cube axes. PBE gives h = 0.289 meV/Å^3, Eg_PBE = 0.215 eV and Eg_HSE-scissor = 0.797 eV, which is just below 0.80 eV. The conduction-band minimum is a single Δ valley (Dx), lowered from 0.607 to 0.215 eV by the [100] compression. Dy and Dz rise to about 0.54 eV, L sits at about 1.27 eV and Γ at about 2.30 eV, so the gap stays indirect. Lateral tension of 0.010–0.012 gave the lowest h; pure Poisson-like lateral strain (~0.0074) needed about 0.30–0.36 meV/Å^3. Shear routes lower Δ as well but cost more energy (e.g. e12 = 0.04 costs 1.56 meV/Å^3). The gap constraint is met only at the scissor level, with a 3 meV margin. Full HSE06 (verify_hse) and the Born stability check (elastic_stability) were blocked by tool permissions, so the constraints are not fully verified. Stability is very likely at strains this small (under 3%), but it was not checked. 80 of 150 budget units remain, enough to run both checks.

verifier.eg_level: full HSE06 (verify_hse); scissor-HSE 0.797 eV; PBE 0.215 eV; indirect, CBM Dx
verifier.stable: yes - Born stable, min stiffness eigenvalue 71.1 GPa
issues: Scissor-HSE gap 0.797 eV satisfies Eg<=0.80 eV by only 3 meV; full HSE06 gives 0.773 eV (27 meV margin).
Scissor overestimates full-HSE gap by ~24 meV here, so a slightly lower-h strain likely also satisfies the constraint at full HSE06; optimality not verified.
Symmetry-equivalent permutations give identical h and gap (consistent).
